appointment_links_revoked_check.name: appointment_links_revoked_check
appointment_links_revoked_check.value: ("appointment_links"."revoked_at" is null) = ("appointment_links"."revoked_reason" is null) and ("appointment_links"."revoked_reason" is null or "appointment_links"."revoked_reason" in ('cancelled','rotated','staff'))

appointments_during_check.name: appointments_during_check
appointments_during_check.value: not isempty("appointments"."during") and lower_inc("appointments"."during") and not upper_inc("appointments"."during") and not lower_inf("appointments"."during") and not upper_inf("appointments"."during")

audit_events_summary_check.name: audit_events_summary_check
audit_events_summary_check.value: length("audit_events"."summary") between 1 and 300 and strpos("audit_events"."summary", chr(10)) = 0 and strpos("audit_events"."summary", chr(13)) = 0

audit_events_target_check.name: audit_events_target_check
audit_events_target_check.value: length("audit_events"."target_kind") between 1 and 40 and ("audit_events"."target_ref" is null or length("audit_events"."target_ref") between 1 and 80)

cash_movements_hash_check.name: cash_movements_hash_check
cash_movements_hash_check.value: ("cash_movements"."idempotency_key" is null) = ("cash_movements"."request_hash" is null) and ("cash_movements"."request_hash" is null or "cash_movements"."request_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

cash_sessions_review_check.name: cash_sessions_review_check
cash_sessions_review_check.value:
("cash_sessions"."reviewed_by" is null) = ("cash_sessions"."reviewed_at" is null)
        and ("cash_sessions"."reviewed_at" is null or (("cash_sessions"."needs_review" or "cash_sessions"."opening_needs_review") and "cash_sessions"."closed_at" is not null))
        and (not "cash_sessions"."needs_review" or "cash_sessions"."closed_at" is not null)

cash_sessions_closed_check.name: cash_sessions_closed_check
cash_sessions_closed_check.value:
("cash_sessions"."closed_at" is null) = ("cash_sessions"."closed_by" is null)
        and ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" is null) = ("cash_sessions"."closing_counted" is null)
        and ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" is null) = ("cash_sessions"."expected_cash" is null)
        and ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" is null) = ("cash_sessions"."difference" is null)
        and ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" is null) = ("cash_sessions"."close_idempotency_key" is null)
        and ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" is null) = ("cash_sessions"."close_request_hash" is null)

cash_sessions_difference_check.name: cash_sessions_difference_check
cash_sessions_difference_check.value:
"cash_sessions"."difference" is null or ("cash_sessions"."difference" = "cash_sessions"."closing_counted" - "cash_sessions"."expected_cash"
        and ("cash_sessions"."difference" = 0) = ("cash_sessions"."closing_entry_id" is null)
        and ("cash_sessions"."difference" = 0 or length(trim("cash_sessions"."note")) > 0))

commission_settlement_lines_shape_check.name: commission_settlement_lines_shape_check
commission_settlement_lines_shape_check.value:
("commission_settlement_lines"."kind" in ('commission','clawback')) = ("commission_settlement_lines"."sale_line_id" is not null)
        and ("commission_settlement_lines"."kind" = 'adjustment') = ("commission_settlement_lines"."reason" is not null)
        and ("commission_settlement_lines"."reason" is null or length(trim("commission_settlement_lines"."reason")) between 3 and 300)

commission_settlement_lines_amount_check.name: commission_settlement_lines_amount_check
commission_settlement_lines_amount_check.value:
"commission_settlement_lines"."amount" <> 0 and "commission_settlement_lines"."amount" % 100 = 0 and abs("commission_settlement_lines"."amount") <= 10000000000000
        and ("commission_settlement_lines"."kind" not in ('commission','carry_over') or "commission_settlement_lines"."amount" > 0)
        and ("commission_settlement_lines"."kind" not in ('clawback','advance_deduction') or "commission_settlement_lines"."amount" < 0)

commission_settlements_payout_check.name: commission_settlements_payout_check
commission_settlements_payout_check.value:
"commission_settlements"."payout" = "commission_settlements"."commission_total" - "commission_settlements"."clawback_total" + "commission_settlements"."tips_total" + "commission_settlements"."adjustments_total" - "commission_settlements"."advance_deduction" + "commission_settlements"."carry_over"
        and "commission_settlements"."payout" >= 0 and "commission_settlements"."commission_total" >= 0 and "commission_settlements"."clawback_total" >= 0 and "commission_settlements"."advance_deduction" >= 0 and "commission_settlements"."carry_over" >= 0
        and not ("commission_settlements"."advance_deduction" > 0 and "commission_settlements"."carry_over" > 0) and ("commission_settlements"."carry_over" = 0 or "commission_settlements"."payout" = 0)
        and "commission_settlements"."payout" <= 10000000000000

commission_settlements_whole_pesos_check.name: commission_settlements_whole_pesos_check
commission_settlements_whole_pesos_check.value:
"commission_settlements"."commission_total" % 100 = 0 and "commission_settlements"."clawback_total" % 100 = 0 and "commission_settlements"."tips_total" % 100 = 0 and "commission_settlements"."adjustments_total" % 100 = 0
        and "commission_settlements"."advance_deduction" % 100 = 0 and "commission_settlements"."carry_over" % 100 = 0 and "commission_settlements"."payout" % 100 = 0

commission_settlements_paid_from_check.name: commission_settlements_paid_from_check
commission_settlements_paid_from_check.value:
("commission_settlements"."paid_from" is null) = ("commission_settlements"."payout" = 0) and ("commission_settlements"."paid_from" is null or "commission_settlements"."paid_from" in ('cash','bank'))
        and ("commission_settlements"."cash_session_id" is not null) = ("commission_settlements"."paid_from" is not distinct from 'cash')

commission_settlements_reversed_check.name: commission_settlements_reversed_check
commission_settlements_reversed_check.value:
("commission_settlements"."status" = 'reversed') = ("commission_settlements"."reversal_entry_id" is not null)
        and ("commission_settlements"."status" = 'reversed') = ("commission_settlements"."reversed_at" is not null)
        and ("commission_settlements"."status" = 'reversed') = ("commission_settlements"."reversed_by" is not null)
        and ("commission_settlements"."status" = 'reversed') = ("commission_settlements"."reversal_idempotency_key" is not null)
        and ("commission_settlements"."status" = 'reversed') = ("commission_settlements"."reversal_request_hash" is not null)
        and ("commission_settlements"."status" <> 'reversed' or length(trim("commission_settlements"."reversal_reason")) between 3 and 300)

sale_lines_amounts_check.name: sale_lines_amounts_check
sale_lines_amounts_check.value:
"sale_lines"."unit_price" >= 0 and "sale_lines"."discount" >= 0 and "sale_lines"."discount" <= "sale_lines"."unit_price" and "sale_lines"."net" = "sale_lines"."unit_price" - "sale_lines"."discount"
        and "sale_lines"."commission" >= 0 and "sale_lines"."commission_bps" between 0 and 10000

sale_payments_cash_check.name: sale_payments_cash_check
sale_payments_cash_check.value:
case when "sale_payments"."kind" = 'cash'
        then "sale_payments"."tendered" is not null and "sale_payments"."change" is not null and "sale_payments"."change" >= 0 and "sale_payments"."tendered" - "sale_payments"."change" = "sale_payments"."amount" and "sale_payments"."fee" = 0
        else "sale_payments"."tendered" is null and "sale_payments"."change" is null end

sales_voided_check.name: sales_voided_check
sales_voided_check.value: ("sales"."status" = 'voided') = ("sales"."void_entry_id" is not null) and ("sales"."status" = 'voided') = ("sales"."voided_at" is not null)

staff_advances_reversed_check.name: staff_advances_reversed_check
staff_advances_reversed_check.value:
("staff_advances"."status" = 'reversed') = ("staff_advances"."reversal_entry_id" is not null)
        and ("staff_advances"."status" = 'reversed') = ("staff_advances"."reversed_at" is not null)
        and ("staff_advances"."status" = 'reversed') = ("staff_advances"."reversed_by" is not null)
        and ("staff_advances"."status" = 'reversed') = ("staff_advances"."reversal_idempotency_key" is not null)
        and ("staff_advances"."status" = 'reversed') = ("staff_advances"."reversal_request_hash" is not null)
        and ("staff_advances"."status" <> 'reversed' or length(trim("staff_advances"."reversal_reason")) between 3 and 300)

time_off_during_check.name: time_off_during_check
time_off_during_check.value: not isempty("time_off"."during") and lower_inc("time_off"."during") and not upper_inc("time_off"."during") and not lower_inf("time_off"."during") and not upper_inf("time_off"."during")

void_requests_decided_check.name: void_requests_decided_check
void_requests_decided_check.value:
("void_requests"."status" = 'pending') = ("void_requests"."decided_by" is null) and ("void_requests"."status" = 'pending') = ("void_requests"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("void_requests"."status" = 'pending') = ("void_requests"."decision_idempotency_key" is null) and ("void_requests"."status" = 'pending') = ("void_requests"."decision_request_hash" is null)
        and ("void_requests"."status" <> 'rejected' or length(trim("void_requests"."decision_note")) > 0)
